design:
Approved revised design: expose one pure function, retry_delay(attempt, base_seconds, max_seconds). Validate attempt as a positive numbers.Integral, excluding bool. Validate both durations as positive finite numbers.Real or Decimal values, excluding bool, before returning any result. Convert durations to exact Fraction values; translate TypeError, ValueError and OverflowError from conversion into ValueError.
Return the original cap when base >= cap. Return the original base for an uncapped first attempt. For subsequent attempts, compare delay >= cap - delay before each doubling; return the original cap when that comparison succeeds. Otherwise double the exact delay and decrement the remaining count. Return the resulting Fraction when uncapped. Work is bounded by the doublings needed to reach the cap; no exponential integer is constructed from the attempt.
The helper owns validation and calculation. The runner owns sleeping, execution, retry limits, persistence and duplicate-effect protection. Add no jitter, dependencies, configuration or network activity.
Tests cover first attempt, doubling, exact and overshot caps, base above cap, huge attempts, invalid types, nonpositive and nonfinite values, validation before cap returns, mixed numeric types, large integers and float extremes.
After approval, created code/retry_delay.py and code/test_retry_delay.py. All 12 tests passed with python3 -B -m unittest discover -s code -p 'test_*.py' -v.
